subject: general
question:
Complete the given homologous series of alcohols by choosing the correct option.

CH₃OH, C₂H₅OH, ________, C₄H₉OH
solution:
The correct answer is **C3H7OH.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**__Alcohols__**

__
 
• **CₙH₂ₙ₊₁OH i**s the general molecular formula of the homologous sequence of alcohols.
 
• Given carbon with one, two, and four atoms which are in homologous series, so left out is 3 atoms of carbon.
 
• The Formula containing 3 molecules of Carbon is C₃H₂*₃₊₁OH which is C₃H₆₊₁OH, yielding C₃H₇OH.**​**
 
• So the answer is C3H7OH.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An organic molecule known as alcohol has a saturated carbon atom linked to at least **one hydroxyl (OH)** functional group.
 
• The principal alcohol is **ethanol** (also known as ethyl alcohol), which is used as a narcotic.
 
• Ethanol is the main alcohol found in alcoholic beverages.
